# FastBreak

**Category:** World  
**Aliases:** FastBreak, Speed Mine, SpeedMine, Speedmine

## What it does

FastBreak lets you mine and break blocks faster than vanilla normally allows. While it's enabled, the time it takes for a block to break is shortened, so you can clear terrain, harvest, or dig through obstacles much more quickly.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://liquidbounce.net/docs/modules/world/fastbreak). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
